LanguageData.USAC_RookieRockefeller.label: Rookie Rockefeller
LanguageData.USAC_RookieRockefeller.description: Rookie is the face of United Stellar Armament: a profitable war broker, a synthetic android of humble origins who these days pays his electricity bill in full. He will keep your colony's fragile lifeline going with contracts, quarterly subscriptions and whatever the orbital suppliers have in stock.\n\nStay active and stay armed, and the revenue keeps coming. Fall behind, and his polite reminders become a liquidation deadline.
